question: Among every source-admitted extra query view on the consumed eleventh family, does any one view expose enough different evidence for the unchanged candidate scorer to recover target Top-1, and is a local one-step view sufficient?

baseline.frozen_interpretation: Initial Top-1 is 0/2 and Recall@3 is 2/2; the literal bounded-set gate passed, but propagation supplied zero direct or incremental hits.

panel.wide_baseline_definition: Every other source-admitted view, reported separately from the one- and two-frame-forward local views.

oracle_metrics: view evidence receipt including target visibility, box geometry and frame baseline

literature_motivation.source: PInVerify: An Offline Embodied Benchmark for Active Instance Verification
literature_motivation.use: Motivates measuring an oracle ceiling before policy training because random, angular-farthest and MLLM next-best-view strategies showed no reliable separation in the reported benchmark.

literature_motivation.source: Active Perception for Ambiguous Objects Classification
literature_motivation.use: Motivates selecting a view that minimizes ambiguity between visually similar candidates rather than choosing the clearest or most distant view.

forbidden_after_freeze: drop a source-admitted extra view after seeing RGB or model output
change the reference images, proposal pool, models, score, Top-1 definition or IoU 0.5 target-hit gate
tune on frames 82 or 83, train a policy, enlarge the initial three-slot set, or call a random or farthest view oracle
merge local one-step and wide-baseline results into one claim
claim_boundary: This is consumed-family Development and an oracle ceiling for query-side view informativeness under one unchanged scorer. It cannot establish a runnable view policy, fresh transfer, calibrated uncertainty, exact-instance binding, portal ownership, affordance, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, benefit, reliability or safety.
